verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for a hosting and automation platform like Hugging Face, so the axis applies. The pack shows only adjacent capabilities: running a one-off job, uploading files to a repo, and repo webhooks. Nothing documents versioning, review, or rollback of automation definitions such as jobs or webhooks, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
